title: learning-routing
description: Classify learnings into memory, skills, or project records. Keeps global agent context compact by deciding whether feedback, an incident, or a solution belongs as durable user memory, a reusable skill, or repo-scoped project knowledge — without duplicating detail across all three.

title: proof-bearing-verification
description: Prove behavior before declaring engineering work complete. A green command, static review, or agent summary is not proof unless it exercises the claimed behavior at a real seam — mounted component, CLI invocation, API call, or end-to-end flow.

title: carousel
description: Generates LinkedIn carousel slides (HTML + PDF) with a custom dark galaxy theme — gradient text, symmetric top/bottom starfield brightness, and real headless-Chrome rendering instead of static mockups.

title: buffer
description: Schedule and publish social posts across connected channels via the official Buffer CLI — queue scheduling, dry-run validation before every live mutation, and idempotency-safe post management.
